summary: Do not rely on exact implementation-generated message text for ECMAScript runtime errors.

target.notes: Exact engine diagnostic strings require an explicitly selected JavaScript engine compatibility profile; there is no generic C# lowering.

semantics.specified: error category/type and triggering semantics may be specified
semantics.not_portable: exact diagnostic message text is implementation-defined or host/engine-sensitive
semantics.policy: translation must not synthesize a CLR message and claim byte-for-byte JavaScript equivalence

caveats: User-supplied Error(message) text is portable and is covered by error.constructor.message.

tests.name: typeerror message engine-specific
tests.expected_behavior: name is TypeError and message is a string; exact text is not portable

tests.name: syntax errors diagnostic varies
tests.expected_behavior: reports a SyntaxError-like diagnostic whose exact message should not be asserted cross-engine
